findings.detail: run_guard.canonical_artifacts names the TrackEval target as <trackers>/MOT20-val/<run_id>, but the evaluator was staged as <run_id>__R0/__R1/__R2, so that path does not exist and that leg of the non-reuse guard never fires. Re-launch is still refused by the other seven legs (R0, R2, detector_cache, embedding_cache_dir, run_log_dir, run_manifest, stv_output), so the single-use property holds. Not repaired here.

findings.detail: every R1 coordinate equals round(source, 2) exactly, with zero exceptions over 2,223,712 coordinates; 97.11 percent are already bit-identical and the maximum deviation is 0.005, the half-ulp of two-decimal rendering. Unlike the tracker score field, coordinates ARE evaluated, so this rendering is visible to the evaluator. It is the same writer convention as the frozen MOT17 V9 R1 files, which the execution task reproduced byte-for-byte, so R1 is comparable across the two datasets.
findings.title: R1 coordinates are the two-decimal rendering of their source, not bit-identical copies
